title: Office - I. Remove a completed inspection
preconds: Logged in as Office. WOL View only, but Settings + Service ON. A line has a completed inspection with a generated PDF report.
steps:
1. Log in.
2. Open the line with a completed inspection.
3. Look for / click the bin (remove) icon.
4. Confirm removal if prompted.
expected: Step 3: The remove (bin) control is NOT available - deleting a completed inspection requires WOL Delete (SV-8095 AC3B).
